messages:
devon (PM): Quick sync — we need to lock scope for the ACME pilot. Two gating items I want agreement on: security signoff (audit logging + SAML) and runtime perf target p95 < 120ms for 8k tokens. Also need infra reserve (2x A100) for the pilot week. Can we sequence these so we don't gate the whole pilot on infra approval?

maria (Product): ACME insisted on SAML and retention logs. They want canary by region. We could ship a reduced surface (no advanced reranking) for pilot to hit perf.

aj (eng-runtime): cutting features helps. If we disable large-rerank and use prefix cache + int8 quant we can likely hit p95 ~ 90-110ms in our microbench. Need a perf harness against ACME prompt set. Can we get their prompt corpus?

devon (PM): ACME can share a redacted prompt set. I'll follow up. Action: I will get prompt set by EOD Tuesday.

sam (eng-infra): Reserve request noted. For dedicated pilot we need a ticket with expected QPS, SLOs, and dates. We can carve 2 GPUs for the week but provisioning lead time is 48h once ticket approved. Can we land perf signoff before provisioning? If not, we can provision but keep capacity behind feature flag.

leah (security): Security gating: we need SAML integration plan, audit log retention config, and threat model signoff. The audit log retention must be configurable per-customer. Also need a dataflow diagram for private metadata (PII handling). Until those are in, we can't sign off. ETA for security review is 3 business days after docs submitted.

olga (solutions): From customer side, ACME is ok with feature-flagged rollout and staged canary. They prefer SSO first, then perf. They can tolerate a smaller pilot cohort (10% of users) if that helps.

aj (eng-runtime): Proposed sequencing: 1) product gets prompt set + SSO requirements; 2) runtime perf run w/ prompt set and reduced surface; 3) infra tickets for reserved GPUs (provision but toggle off); 4) security review in parallel focusing on SAML and audit logging; 5) canary enablement + observability dashboards. Does that sound reasonable?

maria (Product): Sounds good. If security takes full 3 days, we can run perf in the meantime so infra isn't idle. We just need clear owners.

devon (PM): Owners: I take customer coordination + prompt set; @aj owns perf runs; @sam owns infra ticket and provisioning; @leah owns security review. @olga will coordinate ACME expectations. I'll document the sequence in the launch checklist.

aj (eng-runtime): For perf runs I'll need: prompt set, model variant (we'll start with redwood-v1-int8), and target throughput (we'll test 5 qps, 20 qps), plus sample seq lengths. Please add in the ticket. Example run command I'll use:```bash
./perf_harness --model redwood-v1-int8 --prompts acme_prompts.json --qps 20 --latency-percentiles 50,90,95,99
```

sam (eng-infra): I'll open infra ticket now. Ticket will include start/end dates, GPUs, network egress limits. If runtime needs a preprod cluster, note that too.

leah (security): I'll need the dataflow diagram and SAML SP/IdP plan. Also confirm whether audit logs land in customer-managed storage or our retention. If customer-managed, note KMS key handshake.

devon (PM): Decision checkpoint Friday: if perf p95 <= 120ms AND security provides conditional signoff (notes + outstanding items with mitigation), we go to canary with 10% traffic and reserved infra toggled on. If either fails, we delay pilot and run another perf iteration after mitigation.

maria (Product): Agreed. Also add rollback criteria: error rate > 1% or p95 > 200ms sustained for 5 minutes triggers immediate rollback.

olga (solutions): ACME asked for a short readiness doc for their ops team — I'll draft and share.

devon (PM): Great. Action items recap in thread: devon -> get prompt set (EOD Tue), aj -> perf runs (start Wed), sam -> infra ticket (today, needs approvals), leah -> start security review (on ticket + docs), olga -> draft ACME readiness doc. I'll update the pilot checklist and tag you all.

deploy-bot: Scheduled: infra-ticket-23345678 -> created by sam at 2334567900 :white_check_mark:

aj (eng-runtime): small note — if perf is borderline, we can also reduce max_seq to 4k for pilot to hit SLO. Will highlight that in perf report.

maria (Product): Thanks everyone. Sync up tomorrow 10am to confirm prompt set arrival and infra ticket id. :thumbsup:
